result.question: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior queda absoluta de internações entre os períodos 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?
result.gold_sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n1 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n2 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", p1.n1 AS periodo_2008_2012, p2.n2 AS periodo_2019_2023, (p1.n1 - p2.n2) AS queda_absoluta FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = p2."DIAG_PRINC" JOIN cid c ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE p1.n1 > 1000 ORDER BY queda_absoluta DESC LIMIT 10;
result.generated_sql: WITH internacoes_periodo AS ( SELECT i."DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano FROM internacoes i WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") IN (2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023) GROUP BY i."DIAG_PRINC", ano ), total_internacoes AS ( SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", SUM(CASE WHEN ano BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 THEN total_internacoes ELSE 0 END) AS total_2008_2012, SUM(CASE WHEN ano BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 THEN total_internacoes ELSE 0 END) AS total_2019_2023 FROM internacoes_periodo GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC" ) SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, (total_2008_2012 - total_2019_2023) AS delta_temporal, total_2008_2012, total_2019_2023 FROM total_internacoes t JOIN cid c ON t."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" ORDER BY delta_temporal DESC LIMIT 10;
